design: sim/systems/traverse7.gd + content/g7/rules_g7_traverse.json (all under _traverse7; Content skips _ keys). Saved+hashed e.tf (bearing), e.tft (last lay tick), e.tfh (hold-until tick), e.tfa (target id of the last lay). lay(w,e,to,cd_s,indirect,tid) slews at the per-def rate and returns laid (tol 5 deg, 10 indirect); called only on ready ticks (no per-tick cost between shots, catch-up of <= 10 ticks only while tracking the SAME target); bearing(w,e,tick) is a pure function (hold, then return to rest at the same rate; direct-fire building mounts scan +-20 deg over 16 s) read by render_snap as tb. Modes: turret (mbt, ifv, 4 CN APCs: hull never swings), hull (turreted vehicles / ships with no separate turret art: the hull lays at the gun rate instead of snapping; on the move unchanged), building (every armed building, Turrets7, WallTurret7). Rates PROVISIONAL (mbt 40, ifv 60, APC mounts 138 = apc_gun7's 2.4 rad/s, RWS 140, heavy naval 20-25, hmg nest 120, rail 25, derived for other buildings).
